info.name: BMWC → WMS Bridge — Demo & Integration Tests
info.description:
Customer-facing demo collection for the BMWC to WMS integration bridge on Azure Integration Services.

Covers 7 scenarios:
  1. Success — standard multi-line order
  2. Success — URGENT order with GMT+8 timestamp (timezone normalisation demo)
  3. Success — EXPEDITE order with lot-tracked and serialised items
  4. Transient failure — WMS unavailable (demonstrate retry + DLQ path)
  5. DLQ demo — permanent WMS fault, dead-letter queue consolidation
  6. Invalid request — missing required fields (schema validation gate)
  7. Idempotency — duplicate orderId within dedup window

Setup:
  1. Create an Environment named 'BMWC Demo' with the variables below.
  2. Run request #0 (Health Check) to verify the mock WMS is running.
  3. Work through requests 1–7 in sequence, observing outputs at each layer.

Required environment variables:
  apimGatewayUrl      — https://<your-apim>.azure-api.net
  subscriptionKey     — APIM subscription key (from APIM portal → Subscriptions)
  mockWmsUrl          — http://localhost:8080  (or container URL)
  correlationId       — auto-set by Pre-request Script in each request

request.description:

Presenter note: This simulates querying the real WMS endpoint for its service contract. In production the WSDL URL comes from the WMS vendor and is hard-coded in the wms-soap-dispatcher workflow.

PRIMARY HAPPY PATH

A standard 3-line order with UTC timestamp and a lot-tracked item on line 3.

Expected response: 202 Accepted with JSON body containing orderId and correlationId.

What to show audience:
  1. Response is 202 (not 200) — message accepted for async processing
  2. X-Correlation-ID echoed in response header
  3. Navigate to Service Bus → wms-inbound queue → Messages to show the enqueued message
  4. Navigate to Logic App → bmwc-rest-ingress → Run History to show the run
  5. Navigate to Logic App → wms-soap-dispatcher → Run History to show the WMS call
  6. Navigate to Log Analytics → query WMS_DISPATCH_SUCCESS for this orderId

request.description:
TIMEZONE NORMALISATION DEMO

The caller submits orderDate as 2026-04-10T10:00:00+08:00 (10 AM Malaysian time).
The bmwc-rest-ingress workflow normalises this to UTC: 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z.
The Service Bus message and SOAP payload both use the UTC value.

In the reporting layer (Power BI / Workbook), timestamps are displayed as GMT+8 for human readability — but the raw value stored and transmitted is always UTC.

What to show audience:
  1. Page through Service Bus message body — show orderDate is 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z (UTC)
  2. Open Log Analytics → AppTraces → show enqueuedAtUtc field
  3. Open the optional reporting workbook — show the same event rendered as 10:00 AM MYT
  4. Emphasise: single source of truth is UTC; GMT+8 is a display-only concern

item.name: 04 — Transient Failure Demo (stop WMS mock first)

request.description:
TRANSIENT FAILURE DEMO — PRE-STEP: Stop the WMS mock container before sending this request.

Setup:
  docker stop wms-soap-mock   (or kill the node process)

Expected outcome:
  1. APIM returns 202 immediately — ingress is fire-and-forget
  2. Message lands on Service Bus wms-inbound queue
  3. wms-soap-dispatcher picks up message, fails to connect to WMS
  4. Logic App retries 3× with exponential back-off (visible in Run History)
  5. After maxDeliveryCount attempts Service Bus moves message to DLQ
  6. dlq-monitor fires on next 15-min schedule and logs DLQ_ALERT_SUMMARY

Restore:
  docker start wms-soap-mock
  Then use the 'Resubmit from DLQ' Azure Portal feature or submit a new order with the same content.

exec: pm.test('Returns 202 — ingress accepted even when WMS is down', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });

request.description:
DLQ DEMO — Submit this request 3 times, incrementing orderId each time:
  ORD-2026-DLQ-001, ORD-2026-DLQ-002, ORD-2026-DLQ-003

The WMS mock is configured to return a SOAP Fault for warehouseCode 'WH-DLQ' or SKU 'SKU-X-999'.

What to show:
  1. Service Bus → wms-dead-letter-review queue — 3 messages appear
  2. Log Analytics → AppTraces | where Properties.event == 'WMS_SOAP_FAULT'
  3. Log Analytics → DLQ_ALERT_SUMMARY emitted by dlq-monitor (wait 15 min or trigger manually)
  4. Azure Monitor alert fires (if action group wired)
  5. Demonstrate 'Resubmit from DLQ' after fixing the SKU

SCHEMA VALIDATION GATE DEMO

Missing: orderId (required) and lines (required array, min 1 item).

Expected response: 400 Bad Request.
Message NEVER reaches Service Bus — the validation gate fires in the Logic App trigger.

What to show:
  1. Response is 400 with a validation error body
  2. Service Bus queue message count does NOT increment
  3. No run appears in wms-soap-dispatcher run history
  4. Emphasise: only well-formed orders consume Azure resources

exec: pm.test('Error body references missing field', function() {

request.description:
IDEMPOTENCY DEMO

Send after request #01 (within 10 minutes). Same orderId = ORD-2026-SGP-001.
Service Bus duplicate detection window is 10 minutes.

Expected behaviour:
  - APIM: 202 Accepted (ingress does not distinguish)
  - Service Bus: message silently deduplicated — NOT re-delivered to dispatcher
  - Log Analytics: no new ENQUEUE_SUCCESS event for this orderId after the first
  - WMS: NOT called a second time

What to show:
  1. Service Bus → wms-inbound → Active Message Count does NOT go up
  2. wms-soap-dispatcher run history shows no new run after the duplicate
  3. Explain: orderId is the Service Bus messageId — guaranteed at-most-once delivery
